hero.note: Standalone hero tests should stay deterministic; retries are exceptional.

matrix.note: Matrix suites may retry once, but unstable rows still require case-level debugging.

meta.note: Meta guardrails should fail loudly without retries.

soak.note: Soak coverage is intentionally long-running and should be triaged manually.

heavy-runtime.note: Heavy-runtime tests may retry once but should still report instability explicitly.
